entities.name: 康威定律 (Conway)
entities.how_described: 本集引用它来说明问题：编译器的处理步骤数取决于参与团队数，如果没有统一协议，你交付的产品架构就会是公司的组织架构图

evidence.quote: You know, this guy Conway said that the number of stages or passes in your compiler is going to be dictated by the number of teams you have working on the compiler.

evidence.quote: And the internet has a bunch of things in its security model, like the same origin policy that makes sure that if a website is serving you code, it's only able to execute on its own data.
